title: Curate corpus to >= 150 articles (gate-passed, provenanced)
context: This task scales the corpus to >= 150 gate-passed, provenanced articles with an honestly reported license mix. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Every article carries a committed gate artifact and complete provenance; per-article original licenses are retained.
objective: Curate the corpus to >= 150 OA articles, each gate-passed with a committed artifact and complete provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: >= 150 OA articles curated, each gate-passed with a committed artifact and complete provenance.
License mix recorded honestly (per-article original license retained; redistributable vs metadata-only counts reported).
Corpus validates against schema-002; dedup applied; CI green.
